plan.title: Explore data structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) image count and sizes in data/train/images/, (2) annotations.json structure — number of annotations, categories, images, (3) distribution of annotations per image, (4) distribution of annotations per category, (5) category names and IDs, (6) check for 'corrected' field, (7) examine data/products/ structure and data/metadata.json.
plan.success_criteria: Clear understanding of data dimensions, category distribution, image sizes, reference product availability logged to stdout

plan.title: Setup environment and create train/val split
plan.hypothesis: We can create a proper 90/10 stratified split and verify all dependencies work
plan.description: Install/verify ultralytics, torch, torchvision, pycocotools. Create 90/10 train/val split (seed=42) by image, keeping all annotations for each image together. Output train_split.json and val_split.json in COCO format. Target ~223 train / ~25 val images.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, dependency versions printed, CUDA confirmed available

plan.title: Write evaluation function and convert to YOLO format
plan.hypothesis: We can implement the val_score metric and prepare YOLO training data
plan.description: Implement evaluation function computing: detection_mAP@0.5 (single class), classification_mAP@0.5 (357 classes), val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Also convert COCO annotations to YOLO format with proper directory structure and dataset YAML. Test eval function with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function works correctly, YOLO format data created with correct label counts

plan.title: YOLOv8m baseline at 640px with nc=357
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m provides a reasonable baseline, achieving val_score > 0.15
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Skip nano/small to save time - medium is a good starting point. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function.

plan.title: YOLOv8x at 1280px with nc=357
plan.hypothesis: Larger model + higher resolution significantly improves val_score over medium baseline
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=200, batch=4, close_mosaic=50. This should be our strongest single YOLO model.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by 5+ points over YOLOv8m baseline

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 detection-only at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector achieves higher detection_mAP since it doesn't need to distinguish 357 classes
plan.description: Convert all annotations to single class. Train YOLOv8x with nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=200. Compare detection_mAP to nc=357 model.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 is higher than nc=357 model's detection_mAP

plan.title: Explore reference product images and build DINOv2 embedding gallery
plan.description: Examine data/products/ directory coverage vs 357 categories. Load DINOv2-base from torch hub, extract embeddings for all reference product images. Test kNN classification accuracy on val split crops using ground truth boxes. Measure top-1 and top-5 accuracy.
plan.success_criteria: Gallery built, kNN classification accuracy measured on val GT crops

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 kNN classification achieves higher val_score than nc=357 YOLO alone
plan.description: Combine nc=1 YOLOv8x detector with DINOv2-base kNN classification. For each detection, crop from original image, extract embedding, find nearest neighbor in gallery (reference images + training crops). Evaluate full val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best nc=357 YOLO model

plan.title: Tune detection and classification hyperparameters
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS, confidence thresholds, and kNN parameters improves val_score by 2+ points
plan.description: Sweep: NMS IoU [0.4-0.8], confidence [0.05-0.3], kNN k=[1,3,5,7], distance metric [cosine, L2]. Also test augmenting gallery with training crops. Find optimal combination on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by 2+ points over untuned pipeline

plan.title: SAHI tiled inference for dense shelf detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference improves detection of small products, boosting detection_mAP by 3+ points
plan.description: Implement sliced inference: split images into overlapping 1280x1280 tiles with stride 960, run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with NMS/WBF. Evaluate val_score improvement.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improves by 3+ points over single-pass inference

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs base comparison
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large embeddings improve classification mAP by 3+ points over base
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large, rebuild gallery, re-evaluate kNN classification. Check if model fits within 420MB submission budget alongside YOLO weights.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improves, total model size fits budget

plan.title: Store section context priors for classification
plan.hypothesis: Restricting classification candidates by store section improves accuracy
plan.description: Build category-to-section mapping from training data. At inference, classify image section first, then restrict kNN search to products from that section. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves over unrestricted kNN

plan.title: Build and test complete submission pipeline
plan.hypothesis: Complete pipeline runs within 300s and achieves best val_score
plan.description: Write run.py combining best detection (YOLO with/without tiling) + best classification (DINOv2 kNN). Verify correct output format, timing budget, and file size constraints. Use only allowed imports.
plan.success_criteria: Pipeline produces valid predictions.json, runs within 300s, total size < 420MB

plan.title: Final optimization and submission packaging
plan.hypothesis: Final tuning and packaging produces a valid, optimized submission
plan.description: Run final configuration sweep combining all best settings. Optimize inference speed (batched DINOv2, efficient crops). Verify submission constraints: ≤3 weight files, ≤420MB, allowed extensions. Document final val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Submission passes all constraints, val_score is maximized
